invariants.rationale: idPfx is a String parameter and is likely expected to be non-null as per context.
recordItr is dereferenced in the method body with hasNext(), thus must be non-null.
This expresses that recordItr.hasNext() is always defined and returns a boolean without exception at method entry, given prior null check.
idPfx and recordItr should not be equal as they are of unrelated types (String vs Iterator).
For any non-null Java String, length() is non-negative.
